🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
RISK-OFF confirmed: Breadth: 2/11 sectors positive; defensives (Utilities/Healthcare) are the only sectors showing net strength while Tech and Cyclicals are broadly weak, meeting multiple RISK-OFF confirmations. Leadership: Broad (Top 5 performers span 5 sectors) but overall market participation is thin — reduce beta exposure.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Utilities lead: AEP (1W: +4.02% | 1M: +2.56%) ABOVE TREND and sector positive. Healthcare leads: ABBV (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing isolated strength: TGT (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +12.42%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Technology weak: AAPL (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -5.10%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.20% | 1M: -12.69%) BELOW TREND. Materials weak: DOW (1W: -10.86% | 1M: -17.58%) BELOW TREND. Energy weak: XOM (1W: -3.50% | 1M: -11.63%) BELOW TREND and SLB (1W: -12.17% | 1M: -18.20%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTC (1W: +12.47% | 1M: +9.85%) ABOVE TREND; WMB (1W: +6.14% | 1M: -2.60%) RECOVERY; TGT (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +12.42%) ABOVE TREND; ABBV (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND; CAT (1W: +5.18% | 1M: +13.02%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (5 sectors in Top 5) — but breadth remains weak.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: LMT (1W: -8.27% | 1M: -7.20%) BELOW TREND; NFLX (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -18.92%) BELOW TREND; DOW (1W: -10.86% | 1M: -17.58%) BELOW TREND; CME (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -20.04%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -21.97% | 1M: -27.95%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated across high-multiple Tech/Services and Materials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W momentum: INTC (1W: +12.47% | 1M: +9.85%) ABOVE TREND, WMB (1W: +6.14% | 1M: -2.60%) RECOVERY, TGT (1W: +5.85% | 1M: +12.42%) ABOVE TREND. Major divergence: several mega-cap Techs (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA, GOOGL, META) are all BELOW TREND while INTC shows strong outperformance — tactical, not broad-based.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Technology is weak with concentrated selling; major names are BELOW TREND: AAPL (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -5.10%) BELOW TREND, MSFT (1W: -7.20% | 1M: -12.69%) BELOW TREND, NVDA (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND. Sector is under pressure from broad risk-off flows and competitive headlines; watch INTC (1W leader) for short-term momentum.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials mixed-to-weak on the week: JPM (1W: +0.70% | 1M: +8.84%) ABOVE TREND but sector overall 1W negative; CME (1W: -11.44% | 1M: -20.04%) BELOW TREND. Financials showing pockets of strength in banks/large caps but not enough breadth to change regime.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare is one of two positive sectors: ABBV (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND, DHR (1W: +4.15% | 1M: +9.81%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +2.47% | 1M: +3.43%) ABOVE TREND. Defensive bid present; watch MRK (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -0.77%) RECOVERY for confirmation.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor defensive exposure and high-quality Healthcare/Utilities names (ABBV, JNJ, AEP) and reduce exposure to large-cap Techs showing structural weakness (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA) and beaten cyclical high-multiple names. Style: Defensive/Value tilt while market sorts through leadership; stay selective given narrow participation.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTC (1W: +12.47% | 1M: +9.85%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through on momentum; ABBV (1W: +5.58% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND — monitor earnings/catalyst flow. BEARISH: NFLX (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -18.92%) BELOW TREND — continued downside risk; ACN (1W: -21.97% | 1M: -27.95%) BELOW TREND — watch for institutional repositioning.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (one of two sector positives) — sector breadth driving defensive flows. BEARISH: Technology and Materials — both under pressure and likely to remain at risk while risk-off persists.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA (1W: -4.05% | 1M: -7.48%) BELOW TREND — needs sustained weekly clearances to signal base repair. AAPL (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -5.10%) BELOW TREND — watch for breakdown continuation vs short-term support. JPM (1W: +0.70% | 1M: +8.84%) ABOVE TREND — monitor for re-entry strength if financials regain breadth.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
WBD (+90): M&A approval headlines; Communication sector weak so watch whether news translates to sustained strength — divergence risk. GILD (+80): EC label expansion for Trodelvy; GILD not in top list but headline is confirming potential accumulation. MRK (+75): Capvaxive approval talk; MRK (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -0.77%) RECOVERY — sentiment largely confirming short-term price action.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
PFE (-60): Lung cancer trial disappointment; PFE (1W: -7.68% | 1M: -7.18%) BELOW TREND — sentiment confirmed. NFLX (-50): Negative headlines and elevated redemptions; NFLX (1W: -8.74% | 1M: -18.92%) BELOW TREND — confirmed weakness. ACN (-50): Price-target cut headlines align with ACN (1W: -21.97% | 1M: -27.95%) BELOW TREND — confirmed distribution.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

RISK-OFF with a Defensive/Value tilt. JNJ ABOVE TREND, ABBV ABOVE TREND and AEP ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: mega-cap Techs remain a major divergence (AAPL, MSFT, NVDA BELOW TREND) while leadership is narrow despite a broad-sector top-5 this week.
